propositions: Outbound create mutations currently use a single construction-time project value for both Cloud and Data Center transports instead of resolving per-ticket to the correct target project.

The cross-project guard fails closed on any mutation targeting a project outside the single configured project, preventing legitimate multi-project writes even when the target is in the store's mapping.
Create mutations bypass the guard entirely because their key is a local-id placeholder, leaving a gap where stale or typo bindings could create against unsynced projects.
The guard must be relaxed from exact string equality to set membership checking against the store's project mapping, while still rejecting targets outside that set.
Resolution of the target project must happen once during mutation building and be passed to both transports via a reserved payload key to enable multi-project dispatch.
